scope: Individual attached ScriptAction.CreateTextBox component rectangles. Static matched DLL/PDB facts; no original runtime or physical-device observation.

native.get_area: GUIComponentTextBox.GetArea RVA0x1787b0 tests UseTextArea full+0xd2. True calls GetTextArea0x177d50; false calls GUIComponentBox.GetArea0x16b890.
native.factory: ScriptAction.CreateTextBox RVA0x270e79 sets UseTextArea=true after text setup. The portable CreateTextBox factory uses this branch.
native.location: GetTextArea RVA0x177da4..0x177dee adds TextOffsetX/Y full+0x188/+0x18c to GUIComponent.GetLocation0x169a70 when an attached owner exists. GetLocation adds component offset+0x110/+0x114 and component transient offset to actual Thing location. Source CreateTextBox OffsetX/Y reads at0x270a88/0x270aab write component offsets at0x270a94/0x270ab7; text offsets retain zero defaults in the admitted branch. GetLocation does not subtract owner Z.
native.dimensions: RVA0x177df2/0x177e04 converts actual width+0xb90 and height+0xb8c separately with CVTTSS2SI before origin justification.
native.horizontal: RVA0x177e0d..0x177e73 selects TextJustification+0x50a, falling back from UNKNOWN3 to box Justification+0x508. Left0 leaves trunc(originX); Center2 subtracts float(integerWidth)*0.5 from float originX then truncates; Right1 subtracts float(integerWidth) then truncates.
native.vertical: RVA0x177e73..0x177e99 treats both Bottom1 and Center2 as float originY minus float(integerHeight)*0.5, then truncation. Top0 uses the already truncated baseY.
native.top_correction: For nonempty text, RVA0x177ea7..0x177edd checks the actual stored text string and adds trunc(-0.5f*ComponentDataDef.LineSpacingBottom full+0x5a4) to integer baseY. This field is distinct from runtime integer LineSpacingBottom full+0xb48. ComponentData.Defaults zeroes the relevant numeric template at RVA0xa2e71; AutoSetDataProperties reflection can replace the data field.
native.empty: With no line records, RVA0x177d8e returns stored GUIComponent.mArea full+0x20 verbatim. The new-component constructor initializes all four rectangle integers to zero at RVA0x1681ee/0x1681f5. Empty component areas are not inferred from glyphs, owner coordinates or text Width/Height constraints.
native.visibility: Neither GetTextArea nor its area dispatch tests Hide, FadeOpacity, owner alpha or owner visibility. Those draw gates do not erase interaction text areas.

portable_consumer.identity: Matches the actual current owner entity lifetime against the retained component and each body; skips destroyed bodies and expired lifetimes. Preserves separate components rather than unioning maximum extents.
portable_consumer.measurement: Uses the same real original font/glyph/symbol paragraph layout as draw and attachedTextDimensions. Maximum extents and individual areas share one measurement helper.
portable_consumer.empty_storage: Retains the genuine new-component mArea default as separate body storage. The admitted script factory exposes no independent mArea mutation operation.
portable_consumer.publication: Returns rectangles atomically on successful measurement/conversion; failures leave an empty result and explicit error.

limits: Original native mActualWidth/mActualHeight paragraph computation is not newly reconstructed. Current source-glyph word wrapping and block measurement remain the existing portable policy; integer placement rules do not establish full native text metric parity.
Nondefault native TextOffset, transient GUI move offset, ScaleWithOwner and independent mArea mutation require actual retained component consumers before admission.
The existing text runtime rejects UNKNOWN authored justification and unadmitted reflection fields. Its default unknown TextJustification falls back to the admitted box justification.
Nonempty control-only/markup-only paragraphs with no retained text/symbol content reject because exact native line-presence behavior has not been established.
Nonfinite or out-of-signed32 float conversion, and overflowing top-offset addition, reject rather than fabricate native indefinite conversion artifacts.

auto_set_reflection.create_loop: CreateTextBox RVA0x2708fc converts each source value, then RVA0x270930 calls ReflectionHelper.SetProperty<ComponentData>; the returned success byte is not tested before continuing enumeration.
auto_set_reflection.unknown: SetProperty RVA0x27fc91 calls GetPropertyInfo0xaa0c0. Property type0 reaches RVA0x27fca6, returns false without modifying ComponentData, and the CreateTextBox loop continues.
auto_set_reflection.inventory: Complete GetPropertyInfo RVA0xaa0c0..0xad3b2 contains264 distinct multi-character property-name references and two single-character names X/Y. Compiled runtime inventory is componentReflectionFields in native/app/text_runtime.cpp. Name fallback at0xad344 compares the whole five-byte NUL-terminated spelling. Hash and strcmp selection are case-sensitive.
auto_set_reflection.helper_metadata: Unknown Lua helper keys have no native ComponentData effect. In particular a forwarded helper Format key is not in the complete compiled inventory; the original Lua helper has already selected/merged the requested format before the native action.
auto_set_reflection.boundary: Only truly unknown properties skip. Recognized compiled fields without an implemented portable reader/consumer still reject through propertyAt. This is not a blanket unsupported-field fallback.
auto_set_reflection.supported_variable_format: VariableAutoFormat is a real reflected string property: GetPropertyInfo0xab343..0xab368 returns type5 and ComponentDataDef+0x3b0. The portable AutoSet branch retains it and reuses its existing original formatter-switch consumer.
auto_set_reflection.font_size: FontSize is a real reflected integer property, not float: GetPropertyInfo0xabfc1 returns type2, field at ComponentDataDef+0x78; matching PDB mFontSize has builtin type0x74 (signed32). Both reflected conversion and explicit CreateTextBox Int reading retain truncation toward zero.
